grammar.distinct_sparse: two independent labels each assigned to left orright; support1..4; same coefficient rule
grammar.same_sparse: e+f<=4, support1..3, primitive integer coefficients±1,±2, firstpositive

selection: per family and baseline-recovery lane: cofinal auxiliary, strongest proved power, term count, coefficient size, ordinal; also mixed-channel lane
source_basis: B=a_u*a_v,a_u,a_v; supplied exact local rational series
source_masks: smooth-bank base h has at least two distinct prime factors; all units excluded; q coprime to both base indices

difference_channel.paid: its v bank has finite critical norm already at theta=3/4
difference_channel.unproved: the u-weighted difference and common z0 bank still require joint source control

disallowed: equivalent target used as its own premise
finite energy or support identity promoted to a uniform bound

kernel.domain: h>=2, k>=2, q prime; all finite support terms retained
kernel.exact_support: positive kernel implies q>Pplus(h), k<q, gcd(h,q)=1
kernel.high_smooth_variant: replace min(2X,tau_theta(q)) by min(2X,tau_theta(q),h^2) after the sqrt(n) coefficient-prefix peel
kernel.same_largest_prime_diagonal: identically zero by opposed entry conditions

next_productions: fresh-scale covariance with all smooth and bank terms
recurrences whose forcing is a proved source correlation

paid_smooth_prefix.outside_domain_warning: q>n^theta and h>sqrt(n) imply q*h>n; pairing must retain outside-domain compensation

scope.quantifiers: for every epsilon>0, exists C_epsilon independent of X

target.unproved: signed joint energy across fresh dyadic coefficients; kernel support does not bound its signed sum
